• This strategy emphasized the development of domestic industries and reduced dependence on foreign goods.
 
• Policies under this strategy included high tariffs, import restrictions, and the promotion of domestic production.
 
• The aim was to protect nascent industries from international competition and build a robust industrial base.

questions.question: Aman walks at the speed of 5 km/hr and reaches his school 28 minutes late. If he walks at 8 km/hr, then he reaches 35 minutes before the scheduled time. What is the distance of his school from his house?

Take the LCM of 5 and 8, which is 40:

(8D - 5D) ÷ 40 = 1.05.

Simplify:

3D ÷ 40 = 1.05.

Multiply both sides by 40:

3D = 42.

Divide by 3:

D = 14.

Final Answer:

The distance to the school is 14 km.
